resources: approved integration branch and assigned worktrees

deadline_rule: No user-set token or wall-clock cap during initial calibration runs. Actual platform/session limits still apply; interrupted work checkpoints instead of resetting statistics.

allocations.enclosing_accounting: Accumulate all coordinator, council, research, worker, evaluator, repair and retro usage under the same milestone/run lineage. Null means no user-set token/time maximum, not zero or a fabricated finite limit. Resumes retain usage; unknown telemetry is marked unavailable.

scoring: ambiguity, integration, consequence, validation each 0..2; sum 0..8. Tier is a heuristic, not measured quality.
stop_rules: selected prototype checkpoint awaiting human trial
trust: Human evidence must be authenticated, current, unrevoked and bound to exact hashes by an accepted verifier. Assistant-authored JSON and verified=true are not proof.

retention.deletion: explicit human authorization; preserve unresolved runs and receipts

reporting.frequency: after every completed, blocked or interrupted calibration run
metrics: cached input tokens (subset of input where provider semantics specify)
reasoning tokens (subset of output where provider semantics specify)
total tokens without double-counting category subsets
wall time and active agent time separately
monetary cost only with known rates and billable usage
reporting.provenance: Runner/provider usage evidence only; identify unavailable fields and partial coverage. Do not infer exact counts from prose length or infer dollars from account usage percentages.
reporting.rollup: Sum disjoint action/agent records once; dedupe resumes and repeated callbacks by stable identity.
reporting.calibration: After several runs report median, mean, range and sample count by task size before recommending limits.

control_compatibility.evidence: tests/test_dark_factory.py and independent supplied-fact forward check; no live runner/telemetry certification
control_compatibility.adoption: Use the pinned updated source controller or adopt the updated skill generation explicitly; installed copies retain their prior version until deployment.
